Independence of u1,u2 lets w isolate k, proving y orthogonal to each ψ_k's ENTIRE B support, hence rank Tr_A P≤2. If u1(x),u2(x) are dependent for every x, a two-linear-map lemma says either the maps are proportional (contradicting ψ independence) or their combined ranges are one-dimensional, giving common B factor and separability. 2x2_completion: A 2D subspace of C2⊗C2 has one, two or infinitely many product rays by the homogeneous 2×2 determinant polynomial. Infinite rays give common local factor. If the unique ray is double, local unitaries and an orthonormal basis put P=|00⟩⟨00|+|a01+b10⟩⟨a01+b10| with ab≠0; its partial transpose has principal [[1,a conjugate(b)],[conjugate(a)b,0]] of negative determinant, contradicting PPT. If two rays have independent local factors, invertible local filters send them to |00⟩,|11⟩; filtered P has support there and partial transpose's |01⟩,|10⟩ principal block [[0,γ],[conjugate γ,0]], so PPT forces γ=0 and filtered state, hence P, separable.
